> This template is intended for small, unplanned enhancements discovered during existing work.
>
> Large features, new products, major system changes, or future project work should go through the normal planning and prioritization process rather than becoming an unofficial GitHub Issues backlog.

## Summary

Describe the requested enhancement.

## Problem / Opportunity

What problem would this enhancement solve, or what opportunity would it provide?

## Proposed Change

Describe the desired behavior or improvement.

## Value / Benefit

Why would this change be useful?

Examples:

- Improve reliability
- Reduce operator effort
- Improve troubleshooting
- Reduce development effort
- Improve maintainability
- Address customer feedback

## Discovered During

Describe the work, testing, commissioning, support activity, or other effort where this enhancement was identified.

## Scope

Describe what should be included.

## Out of Scope

Identify anything that should specifically **not** be included so this does not unintentionally become a larger project.

## Acceptance Criteria

What needs to be true for this enhancement to be considered complete?

- [ ]
- [ ]
- [ ]

## Proposed Priority

Select one:

- [ ] Critical
- [ ] High
- [ ] Medium
- [ ] Low

Explain the proposed priority if needed:

## Related Work

Link any related:

- Issues
- Pull Requests
- Commits
- Projects

## Additional Context

Add any other useful information.
